headline: Obama order makes changes to two earlier executive orders, one on Puerto Rico's status and one on government contracting.
what_it_does: This order changes the wording of two earlier executive orders. Executive Order 13183 set up a federal task force on Puerto Rico's political status, and Executive Order 13494 dealt with what costs federal contractors can charge the government. The title alone does not say what specific changes were made.
when_it_takes_effect: Signed October 30, 2009; the effective date of the changes is not stated in the source material.
